dogecoin.text: I really dig the blue @Tesla Model Y. Such a classy ride. Jealous that my good friend just got that exact one last week! Hey, I can be classy just like @elonmusk and I support @dogecoin too!
I saw the blue Model Y @Tesla on my way home tonight. Such a dope 'mobile!  @elonmusk knows what he is doing. Will 1000 shares of @dogecoin get me one?!?!?

In my continued quest to get a @Tesla I supported @elonmusk and purchased a small amount of Tesla stock yesterday. At $700+ a share it was kind of tough to buy a full share but one day! Would help if @dogecoin would start sliding back the other way!
